steps: Freeze old population and old archive for generation; rank descending fitness, stable index ties.
For each parent choose op1 with probability lambda; CE[op] increments for every trial.
Draw F from Cauchy(muF[op],.1), resample <=0, clip >1; CR from Normal(muCR[op],.1), clip[0,1].
Uniform pbest from top pool, r1 from old population excluding parent, r2 from old population+old archive excluding parent and r1 identity.
Binomial crossover with forced uniform coordinate; project and evaluate true common-model rate.
Strictly improving trial replaces parent; successful displaced parent queued for archive; record positive gain and F/CR by operator.
Complete generation then combine archived parents and uniformly evict to capacityQ. On deadline publish only already checked incumbent; incomplete generation logged.
For each operator normalize current-generation successful gains into weights; muF=sum(w*F^2)/sum(w*F), muCR=sum(w*CR^2)/sum(w*CR); empty/zero denominator retains old mean.
Every10 generations set lambda=.8 if gain1/CE1 > gain2/CE2 else.2; if either CE zero retain lambda; reset window totals.
At500 generations, if time remains restart with retained incumbent, same next deterministic RNG stream, reset archive/means; no additional time.
